name: program-manager
description: A Windows 3.1 Program Manager clone built with Electron and React

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:main && npm run typecheck:preload && npm run typecheck:renderer
scripts.test:visual:wfw: npm run build && electron scripts/capture-wfw.cjs artifacts/wfw-reference.png reference tests/visual/baselines/wfw-reference.png
scripts.test:visual:wfw-desktop: npm run build && electron scripts/capture-wfw.cjs artifacts/wfw-desktop.png desktop tests/visual/baselines/wfw-desktop.png && electron scripts/capture-wfw.cjs artifacts/wfw-desktop-minimized.png desktop-minimized tests/visual/baselines/wfw-desktop-minimized.png
scripts.test:visual: npm run test:visual:wfw && npm run test:visual:wfw-desktop && npm run test:visual:win95
